paper_title: Inhomogeneous Energy Injection in the 21-cm Power Spectrum: Sensitivity to Dark Matter Decay
notes: Paper forecasts HERA 21-cm power spectrum sensitivity to dark matter decay, presenting projected 95% lower limits on DM lifetime (tau, in seconds) versus DM mass for decays to photons and to e+e-. This constrains DM decay lifetime, not any axion/dark-photon/scalar coupling in the enum. No matching coupling type; no extractable coupling-vs-mass data points.
